clue.text: Unrefined team sport, with good man in charge

parts.note: RU stands for Rugby Union, a team sport
a good man is a saint, abbreviated ST

explanation.surface: A sniffy verdict on a rough team game that has a decent man running things.
explanation.definitionFit: Something rustic is plain and countrified, lacking polish or sophistication.

clue.text: Very concerned with partner

parts.note: re means about or concerning
an ally is a partner

explanation.surface: Someone deeply worried about their spouse.
explanation.definitionFit: Really used as an intensifier means very, as in really good.

clue.text: Brother or sister, on time, collecting one in Asian region

indicators.note: on in a down clue puts the sibling above the rest

parts.note: sib is short for sibling, a brother or sister

indicators.note: collecting means the time takes the one inside itself

parts.note: an era is a period of time
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A sibling arrives punctually to pick someone up in a far-off part of Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: Siberia is the vast northern region of Russia lying in Asia.

clue.text: Enthusiastic about pub also, we hear

indicators.note: we hear means the words are spoken out loud and give a word that sounds the same

parts.note: an inn is a pub and too means also

explanation.surface: Someone keen on the pub as well, so the story goes.
explanation.definitionFit: To be into something is an informal idiom for being keen on it.

clue.text: A cadet's outside with drink and behaves badly

indicators.note: the outside of the word cadet means just its first and last letters

parts.note: to sup is to drink, especially in small mouthfuls

explanation.surface: A young cadet goes out drinking and starts misbehaving.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of cadet's is a link meaning 'is'; only the outer letters C and T of cadet are used.
explanation.definitionFit: To act up is an idiom for misbehaving or showing off, especially of children.

clue.text: Extremely drowsy mother in bed, oddly ousted

indicators.note: in means mother is placed inside the bed

parts.note: a cot is a small bed
ma is mother

indicators.note: oddly means the odd-numbered letters of ousted, the first, third and fifth

explanation.surface: A very sleepy mum in bed, strangely thrown out of it.
explanation.definitionFit: Comatose means in a coma, or loosely so sleepy as to be barely conscious.

clue.text: Severe weather feature? Way round found by marines

parts.note: St is short for Street, a way
O is round in shape
RM is the Royal Marines

explanation.surface: Marines find a way around a bad storm.
explanation.definitionFit: A storm is a violent disturbance of the weather, with strong winds and rain.

clue.text: Work up energy and attempt lines by Chaucer?

indicators.note: up in a down clue means read from the bottom, so backwards

parts.note: op is short for opus, a work
E is the physics symbol for energy
a try is an attempt

explanation.surface: Putting effort into studying some verse by Chaucer.
explanation.definitionFit: Chaucer wrote in verse, so his lines are an example of poetry, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Two similar animals in London road?

definitions.meaning: a pair of related amphibians, one smooth-skinned and one warty
in Cockney rhyming slang, spoken in London, the phrase stands for road

explanation.surface: Some animals found on a street in London.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase names two amphibians and is also Cockney rhyming slang for road, from the rhyme on the last word.

clue.text: Referee, endlessly hard, one using teeth

indicators.note: without its ends, the word hard loses both its first and last letters

parts.note: someone who bites is a biter

explanation.surface: A tough referee who is not above biting the players.
explanation.definitionFit: An arbiter is a judge or umpire who settles a dispute, the same role as a referee.

clue.text: Sounds like cow, eastern US mammal

parts.note: a cow lows, that is, it moos

explanation.surface: An animal from the eastern United States that makes a noise like a cow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sounds like' looks like a homophone signal, but it means makes the sounds of a cow: MOOS.
explanation.definitionFit: The moose is a large deer native to North America, so an example of an American mammal.

clue.text: Old foreign money Marilyn's grabbing, on return

indicators.note: on return means those held letters are read backwards
the name Marilyn's holds a run of letters in its grasp

explanation.surface: Marilyn Monroe snatching some old continental banknotes as she comes home.
explanation.definitionFit: The lira was Italy's currency until the euro replaced it, so it is foreign money no longer used.

clue.text: Culinary device, say, Tim and Reg ruined

parts.note: say introduces an example, abbreviated EG (for example)

indicators.note: ruined means the letters of Tim and Reg are wrecked and rebuilt

explanation.surface: Tim and Reg spoilt some kitchen gadget between them.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' looks attached to the definition but gives EG; 'ruined' turns TIMREG into GTIMER.
explanation.definitionFit: A small sand-glass used in the kitchen to time boiling, so a cooking gadget.

clue.text: Wicked lady's protest over headland

definitions.note: read as wicked lady is, the 's being a link

indicators.note: over in a down clue puts the protest above the headland

parts.note: a demo is a demonstration, a protest
a ness is a headland, as in Loch Ness or Dungeness

explanation.surface: A villainous woman's protest about a headland.
explanation.definitionFit: A demoness is a female demon, which is to say a wicked woman.

clue.text: Father disturbed rest on lift

parts.note: pater is Latin for father, used in old-fashioned English

indicators.note: disturbed means the letters of rest on are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: Dad's nap in the elevator gets interrupted.
explanation.walkthrough: Disturbed shuffles REST ON into NOSTER. It is also the Lord's Prayer, but here the definition is 'lift'.
explanation.definitionFit: A paternoster is a lift of open compartments moving continuously in a loop, still found in some old buildings.

clue.text: Greek character recording wild lions

parts.note: an EP is an extended-play record

indicators.note: wild means the letters of lions are let loose and rearranged

explanation.surface: A Greek man records some wild lions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Greek character' suggests a person; it is a letter of the alphabet.
explanation.definitionFit: Epsilon is the fifth letter of the Greek alphabet.

clue.text: Shore bird flying to cave

indicators.note: flying means the letters of to cave scatter into a new order

explanation.surface: A seabird flies off into a cave.
explanation.definitionFit: The avocet is a black-and-white wading bird with an upturned bill found on coasts and estuaries.

clue.text: Creature that snaps our side's bulbous plant

parts.note: a croc, short for crocodile, snaps its jaws
us is our side, with the 's as a link

explanation.surface: A snapping beast belonging to our team turns out to be a plant.
explanation.definitionFit: The crocus is a spring flower that grows from a corm, a bulb-like organ.

clue.text: Churchman returned, opening alcoholic drink

indicators.note: returned means the churchman's title is read backwards

parts.note: Rev is short for Reverend, a clergyman
a mouth is an opening, as of a river or cave

explanation.surface: A vicar comes back and opens a bottle of something strong.
explanation.definitionFit: Vermouth is a fortified wine flavoured with herbs, an alcoholic aperitif.

clue.text: Fast driver: note vehicle overturning

indicators.note: overturning means the pieces are flipped and read in reverse order

parts.note: re is the second note of the sol-fa scale
a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: A speeding motorist gets a ticket after the car flips.
explanation.definitionFit: A racer is someone who drives in races, at speed.

clue.text: Drug addict heads for urban site expecting rendezvous

indicators.note: heads means the first letter of each of the four following words

explanation.surface: An addict makes for a city spot to meet a dealer.
explanation.definitionFit: A user is slang for someone who takes illegal drugs habitually.

clue.text: Elderly newsman, silver on top

indicators.note: on top in a down clue puts the silver above the newsman

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
ed is short for editor, a newspaper man

explanation.surface: An old journalist with silver-grey hair.
explanation.definitionFit: Aged is a synonym for old or advanced in years.

clue.text: Hoard one hundred yen

parts.note: C is the Roman numeral for one hundred
a yen is a longing, and to ache is to long for something

explanation.surface: A stash of a hundred Japanese yen.
explanation.walkthrough: 'yen' looks like the currency but means a craving.
explanation.definitionFit: A cache is a hidden store of things, which is a hoard.

clue.text: Heavenly upper-class girl, one in middle of dance

indicators.note: in means the girl and the one go inside what follows
the middle of the word dance is everything but its first and last letters

parts.note: gel is the way a posh speaker says girl
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A posh girl dancing in the middle of the floor looks divine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gel' is how a posh speaker says girl, a convention worth knowing.
explanation.definitionFit: Angelic means like an angel, a being of heaven, so heavenly in a loose sense.

clue.text: High-flying singer hurt badly by silence

indicators.note: badly means the word hurt is mangled

parts.note: sh is the command for silence

explanation.surface: A star vocalist is deeply wounded by being silenced.
explanation.walkthrough: 'High-flying singer' suggests a pop star; it is a songbird.
explanation.definitionFit: A thrush is a songbird, a singer that flies high.

clue.text: Evil old US lawyer rebuffed handsome chap

indicators.note: rebuffed means pushed back, so the pieces are read in reverse

parts.note: sin is evil-doing
DA is a District Attorney, a US prosecutor

explanation.surface: A wicked old American attorney gets snubbed by a good-looking man.
explanation.definitionFit: Adonis was a beautiful youth in Greek myth, and the name now means any very good-looking man.
